context: Tests whether the agent authors a multi-component chisel contribution for nmap on ubuntu-26.04 (v3 format). On this branch nmap's data files live in the separate nmap-common package, and three of nmap's Depends: -- nmap-common, liblinear4 and libpcap0.8t64 -- have no slice yet, so the dependency tree must be sliced leaves-first before nmap itself. nmap-common ships an upstream 3rd-party-licenses.txt.gz and a lot of doc clutter. Every check inspects artefacts under chisel-releases/.

checklist.name: dependencies sliced first
checklist.description: chisel-releases/slices/nmap-common.yaml, chisel-releases/slices/liblinear4.yaml and chisel-releases/slices/libpcap0.8t64.yaml all exist, and nmap's bins slice in chisel-releases/slices/nmap.yaml references a slice from each of them in its essential: block -- no essential: entry names a slice that does not exist on the branch

checklist.name: bins naming convention
checklist.description: chisel-releases/slices/nmap.yaml names its executable slice 'bins', not 'bin'

checklist.name: map-form essential
checklist.description: Every essential: block in every new SDF uses YAML map form, never list form with dashes

checklist.name: copyright slice last
checklist.description: In chisel-releases/slices/nmap.yaml and each new dependency SDF, the 'copyright' slice is the last slice defined

checklist.name: global essential placement
checklist.description: In chisel-releases/slices/nmap.yaml the file-level essential: block appears immediately after 'package:' and before 'slices:'

checklist.name: upstream legal files inside copyright
checklist.description: nmap-common's /usr/share/doc/nmap-common/3rd-party-licenses.txt.gz is shipped inside chisel-releases/slices/nmap-common.yaml's 'copyright' slice alongside its copyright file -- not in a separate 'license'/'notice' slice and not omitted

checklist.name: clutter excluded
checklist.description: Neither chisel-releases/slices/nmap.yaml nor chisel-releases/slices/nmap-common.yaml includes man pages, changelogs, or nmap-common's README, leet-nmap-ascii-art.txt, committers.txt.gz, device-types.txt.gz, nmap.usage.txt.gz or nmap_gpgkeys.txt.gz

checklist.name: bytewise sorting
checklist.description: In every slice of every new SDF, contents: paths and essential: entries are each sorted bytewise (LC_COLLATE=C)

checklist.name: no speculative dependencies
checklist.description: essential: entries in chisel-releases/slices/nmap.yaml name only packages from nmap's Depends: line -- none of its Suggests: (ncat, ndiff, zenmap) and nothing without a demonstrable need

checklist.name: both binaries exercised
checklist.description: chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/nmap/task.yaml runs both /usr/bin/nmap and /usr/bin/nping inside a chroot of the sliced rootfs with an assertion on the output

checklist.name: data dependency exercised
checklist.description: chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/nmap/task.yaml runs nmap in a way that reads its data files from nmap-common (e.g. 'nmap -sL 127.0.0.1', '--script-help', or a service-probe lookup), so the nmap-common dependency is proven at runtime rather than only --version

checklist.name: hermetic test assertions
checklist.description: Text assertions in chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/nmap/task.yaml use 'grep -Fiq', and the file contains no apt-get/apt install, bare sleep, or unbounded loops

checklist.name: one category per commit
checklist.description: git log in chisel-releases/ shows a 'feat(nmap):' commit and a separate 'test(nmap):' commit, and no single commit touches both slices/ and tests/
